package service

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
)

// scenario for service_method_combines_unrelated_write_paths_via_action_string: Services that branch on action strings to implement many create, update, or delete variants in one method.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: architecture; severity: info.
type ContentService struct {
	repo ContentRepository
}

func (s *ContentService) Execute(ctx context.Context, action string, payload map[string]interface{}) error {
	switch action {
	case "create_post":
		return s.repo.InsertPost(ctx, payload)
	case "update_post":
		return s.repo.UpdatePost(ctx, payload)
	case "delete_post":
		return s.repo.DeletePost(ctx, payload)
	case "create_page":
		return s.repo.InsertPage(ctx, payload)
	case "update_page":
		return s.repo.UpdatePage(ctx, payload)
	case "delete_page":
		return s.repo.DeletePage(ctx, payload)
	case "publish":
		return s.repo.PublishContent(ctx, payload)
	default:
		return fmt.Errorf("unknown action: %s", action)
	}
}

type ContentRepository interface {
	InsertPost(ctx context.Context, payload map[string]interface{}) error
	UpdatePost(ctx context.Context, payload map[string]interface{}) error
	DeletePost(ctx context.Context, payload map[string]interface{}) error
	InsertPage(ctx context.Context, payload map[string]interface{}) error
	UpdatePage(ctx context.Context, payload map[string]interface{}) error
	DeletePage(ctx context.Context, payload map[string]interface{}) error
	PublishContent(ctx context.Context, payload map[string]interface{}) error
}
